method: Forty separately enumerated targeted original-Word-plan-to-exact-repository source inspections completed before code corrections. Existing source witnesses are not whole-site passing tests. One missing assurance acceptance datum is distinct from source defects.

root_causes.cause: Non-atomic WordPress get_option/delete_option/update_option sequences could permit old index workers to reclaim/release a newer generation lease or write a stale index between preflight and commit.
root_causes.source_fix: Use conditional SQL DELETE by exact serialized lease for reclaim/release, and conditional INSERT/UPDATE by exact lock and exact prior index state for running and final projection; invalidate WordPress option caches, fail closed without DB CAS in bootstrapped WordPress.
root_causes.remaining: Real native MySQL/persistent-object-cache multi-process stress test, index pause/resume acceptance, staging parity are not proven.

root_causes.cause: File25 File24 contract metadata pinned an older reviewed commit while latest verified canonical File24 main and staging matrix were a5b8d499...
root_causes.source_fix: Reconcile File25 source-review pin to exact checked File24 main SHA; preserve compatible 0.99.0 runtime range; no claim of deployed version parity.

root_causes.cause: File25 inserted itself at priority by first truncating all existing external File24 manifests to 98, potentially evicting other owners; manifest omitted completeness-declaration fields required in canonical File24 ModuleRegistry.
root_causes.source_fix: Never truncate another owner list; at 99+ existing manifest entries decline File25 registration and emit bounded capacity event; declare complete typed field names honestly while leaving unverified security test date and level blank.

blockers.description: No accepted File25 security validation timestamp or target verification level exists. Leave latest File24 registry's posture unassessed rather than fabricating ASVS or test sign-off.
Connected WPVibe account has no registered WordPress websites. Cannot freeze Hostinger staging or live deployed artifact/DB from this repository.
File08 target booking and File17 target Follow require owner contract/acceptance; never fabricate a destination.
